create_averager_ema: create an exponential moving average callback function to repeatedly update and average a dict of metrics
build_balancer_class: build a loss balancer that combines multiple losses with configurable weight coefficients and gradient rescaling
run_balancer_backward: run the balancer backward pass to compute combined gradients from multiple named loss tensors

review_balancer_metrics: review the balancer metrics property to inspect loss ratio monitoring data after a backward pass
